criteria.title: Formal regression and direct handoff review
Native preservation and Responses complete handoff

observations.summary: Responses continuation and App integration tests passed for interleaved conversations, process restart, submitted outputs, failure recovery and protection from duplicate dispatch.

Provider handoff tests verified three advertised Design entries, Host execution, terminal receipts and bounded reference image delivery. The live Dome run used two references and retained their source images.
Native and Responses handoff suites passed. The native search tests verified the selected group operation, its input fields, its declared execution route and on-demand usage.
Runtime, Design server, browser component and Chromium cases passed. The Dome recording independently shows a completed model turn with twelve Responses requests and a saved drawing.
Validated 1,102 feature and browser cases across both sources and six TypeScript configurations. The recorded GPT-6.2 Astra drawing completed in four minutes and thirteen seconds.
